title: User is authenticated but not connected.
creator: LivelyChameleon
content:
So after years of blocking Thunderbird and K9 (or now Thunderbird Mobile) my university finally allowed all three apps (Desktop/Android). But apparently Thunderbird has some issues with Exchange Online and only returns "User is authenticated but not connected." - on desktop this can be solved by using a paid addon (Owl for Exchange) which is not ideal, but works. Thunderbird Mobile on the other hand does not offer any solution at the moment.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1399126 https://forum.k9mail.app/t/outlook-oauth2-cannot-connect-to-server-command-namespace-response-4-bad-user-is-authenticated-but-not-connected/
